rules.explanation: reportOnly = true turns every finding into a report entry. Use it while introducing the gate, not for good.

rules.summary: Findings below a severity are hidden
rules.explanation: minSeverity drops findings before anyone sees them. A hidden finding cannot be reviewed or accepted.
An accepted finding is a decision for now. An expiry date makes sure it is looked at again.
The rule no longer applies and its finding is reported again. Review it, then renew or remove the rule.

rules.summary: A service is reached without TLS
rules.explanation: Advisories, metadata or Trivy read over plain HTTP can be changed by anyone on the network path. Use an https URL.

rules.summary: Trivy does not scan this project
rules.explanation: Without Trivy, secrets, licenses and misconfigurations are not checked.

rules.summary: Trivy is taken from the machine
rules.explanation: useInstalled = true runs whatever trivy is installed, unverified and in whatever version. Results then differ between machines.

rules.summary: The baseline may hide any severity
rules.explanation: A baseline without maxSeverity can accept critical findings for good. Limit what it may hold.

rules.summary: The gate has nothing to judge
rules.explanation: The assurance gate is enabled, but no source of findings is. It passes without checking anything.

rules.summary: Internal coordinates are sent to a public repository
rules.explanation: confusion { checkPublicRepository = true } asks the public repository about every module of internalGroups.
